meta_description: Marquis Decorating Services. Interior and exterior painting, decorating, and refurbishment across Nottingham. Free quotes, reliable local tradesman.
hero_eyebrow: Local Painter & Decorator — Quality Finishes, Fair Prices
hero_subhead: Interior and exterior painting done right. We transform tired rooms into spaces you'll love living in.
services_subhead: From fresh walls to full room refurbishment, we handle interior and exterior projects with meticulous attention to detail.

services.title: Interior Painting & Wallpapering
services.desc: Transform your rooms with expert interior painting, or choose from premium wallpapers. We protect your furniture, prep surfaces properly, and deliver a finish that lasts.

services.title: Exterior Painting & Rendering
services.desc: Weatherproof and refresh your home's outside. We paint fascia, soffits, doors, and rendered walls using trade-grade exterior coatings and proven techniques.

services.title: Woodwork & Joinery Finishing
services.desc: Skirting, doors, frames, and fitted wardrobes painted to a furniture-quality standard. We use undercoat and topcoat for a durable, professional finish.

services.title: Damp & Problem-Wall Treatment
services.desc: Address moisture and staining before redecoration. We seal problem walls and apply specialist primers so your new finish stays pristine.

services.title: Bathroom & Kitchen Refurbishment
services.desc: High-moisture rooms need expert prep and moisture-resistant finishes. We paint tiles, cabinets, and walls in kitchens and bathrooms that stay looking fresh.

services.title: Commercial Painting & Office Refresh
services.desc: Keep your business looking professional. We work around your schedule with minimal disruption, and can handle larger multi-room projects.

about_pullquote: I turned to decorating because I saw too many rushed jobs. We do it properly.
about_para_1: Marquis Decorating Services was established over a decade ago in Watnall, Nottingham. What started as one tradesman with a van has grown into a trusted local business known for meticulous work and honest dealing. Every project, from a small bedroom refresh to a full commercial repaint, receives the same care and attention to detail.
about_para_2: Our customers return because we turn up on time, respect your home, and finish what we start to a high standard. We're not the cheapest, but we're fair, and the work speaks for itself. Nottingham families and businesses have trusted us to refresh their spaces for over twelve years.
reviews_heading: What Nottingham Homeowners Say About Us

reviews.text: Marquis painted our lounge and hallway earlier this year. From the first chat about colours and prep, right through to the final coat, everything was professional and organised. He protected all our furniture, cleaned up after himself every day, and the finish is beautiful. Highly recommended.
reviews.author: Claire T.

reviews.text: Had some damp staining on the bedroom wall. Rather than just painting over it, the decorator treated the wall properly first, explained what he was doing, and then painted it. Three months in and no sign of the stain returning. That's the kind of attention to detail you want.
reviews.author: Michael S.

reviews.text: Exterior cladding was looking tired and weathered. Got a free quote, no pressure, and the work was completed in two days. The finish is crisp and fresh. Good honest tradesman. Will definitely use again when the kitchen needs doing.
reviews.author: Jennifer W.
